title: View performance counter data for a Data Collector Set

facts.text: Data Collector Set logs are stored as .blg files in Windows Performance Monitor.
Start Windows Performance Monitor by searching for perfmon.
In navigation pane expand Monitoring Tools and choose Performance Monitor.
In toolbar choose View Log Data button to open Performance Monitor Properties.
Select Log files and choose Add to browse for the log file to view.
Choose Open then OK to display the log data.
